1.text: The only reason you would be here, is to rally me and my Guardians to the cause of the Patreayl Knights.

2.text: It humbles me to say this, but - I will pledge my allegiance, but first we must put an end to this bloodshed. The Inquisitor's leader calls himself "The Sword of Ma’at", he has set up his camp at the Order Fort atop Khabors Pass.

3.text: Nice and High - He will see you coming. Though I have trust that you will find a way inside.

0.text: I will defeat him, to save our town!
Go then and be wary, they will have the upper hand in this fight, it may be wise to bring other Guardians to stand by your side.

1.text: Speak with the Master Smith, Aelfred along the path to Khabors Pass, he may be able to help.

0.text: There’s something off about that man. I have fought many in my lifetime. The War of the Dandelion… the siege of La’fure…

1.text: But nothing compares to crossing blades with that… monstrosity. He channels the Essence, I am sure of it. Great darkness travels through his heart, infusing his weaponry…

2.text: The Inquisitors were supposed to have died out - banned by the Order after it was discovered the inhumanity they forced upon their victims.

3.text: But they've returned, and I fear for this country, more than I have ever done so before…

0.text: What is it why are you running?
You had no qualms about leaving me the first time, no fear of what your actions might bring upon me and MY home...

2.text: The only reason you would be here is to rally me and my Guardians to the cause of the Patreayl Knights.

3.text: Well, you’re deluding yourself if you thought that we would ever join forces with your terrorist knights! No, I will not draw anymore hostile attention from the Order onto my people.

4.text: You’ve brought the anger of the Order upon our heads and upon our homes. So go. Defeat the Inquisitors, kill the one they call "The Sword of Ma'at.” If not for me, then for the ease of your own conscience!

0.text: Thank the goddess, today is not the day we die. It seems that you've continued your training in the art of fighting though, and I can acknowledge a great warrior.

1.text: Defeating the Sword of Ma'at was no easy task, you have proven yourself as a great warrior.

0.text: Even after all that has transpired, you’d dare ask me to do that? Blast you, $NAME. Have learnt nothing in your time away?

1.text: I will not support a terrorist group that defies the truth of Ma’at. No. When the Order sends more men to find out what happened here, we will simply have to try reason with them, and hope that it does not get us all killed.

2.text: It seems that you have continued your training in the art of fighting though, and I can acknowledge a great warrior when I see one.

3.text: Take this ring. Not because I care for you as I once did, but as a token from one warrior to another.
